reviews.title: Not the worst game ever… Not the best
reviews.text:
Blind accessible, but not the absolute easiest for blind players. But, I haven't found anything that is not usable through voiceover so that's a huge plus. There are some aspects of the game that are randomized in a fashion that make successful level completion very difficult if not impossible, which then present an option of spending real money into the game to be able to try again…
 I don't like that. If it's a free game, let it be free. Let it be playable-- reasonably so, with more than a 0.5% chance of successful completion in some cases-- without a need to pay real money in to gain successful level completion.
That said, it's still enjoyable enough that I am still playing it. of course, the pickings are few for voiceover users in fully accessible games, so perhaps if there was something better I wouldn't be playing this as much? But as things are now, there's not something better, so I still do play and sure, I recommend it, but it's a tough go if you don't pay real money in.

reviews.title: Pretty surprising
reviews.text: The game is actually a lot of fun. I was expecting rigged RNG to encourage players to shell out cash for progress. I thought the other reviews were paid/bots. But this is a very good game made by someone who seemed to actually be interested in making something with replayability, and not a cash grab. Obviously, the nature of text-based RPGs causes them to be a bit repetitive. It's the RNG that creates a new story. Sometimes you get really spooned, sometimes you die to a willow branch on day 3 in a ruin with only a rusty dagger and straw shield to your name because the river ate your ring. So far, 10/10. It's only getting a 4/5 because i refuse to take accountability for my skill issue

reviews.title: Very fun
reviews.text: This game is well crafted and enjoyable. I do have an issue with the mage class though. From what I can tell the mage’s niche ability doesn’t work. I’m pretty much playing a character with no benefits what so ever. I can’t cast spells repeatedly in combat. Also spells doubling even as the mage is nuts. There’s almost no incentive to cast spells unless you’re loaded with mana pots and treasure. I don’t think the increase should be removed but for a mage it shouldn’t be as debilitating. I get it’s supposed to be hard but i’m practically playing a character with zero special abilities or traits.
